rationale: Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ϯ- ('give') + ϩⲁⲡ ('judgment') = 'one who gives judgment' = judge. Standard agentive parallel to ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.' Functions as Coptic equivalent of κριτής (which appears alongside it) — confirming the reading. Used in apposition with ⲕⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ throughout this kephalaion.
Verbal idiom: ϯ- ('give') + ϩⲁⲡ ('judgment'). The active verb underlying the agentive ⲣⲉϩ†ⲍⲉⲡ 'judge.' Used repeatedly in this chapter for the cosmic act of judging.
Lyc. ⲍⲱⲧ- = Sah. ϩⲱⲧ- intensive/reflexive + ⲧⲏⲛⲉ 2pl pronoun. Equivalent to ⲛ̄ⲧⲱⲧⲛ̄ ϩⲱⲧⲧⲏⲩⲧⲛ̄ 'you yourselves.' Standard Lycopolitan construction.
Lyc. ⲕⲟⲩⲛ-ⲥ̄ 'her/its bosom' (with possible vocalic doubling). Container-noun for inner contents; fits 'wickednesses that are in their bosom' = inherent to them.
Lyc. preposition ⲛⲙ̄- ('with') + 2pl pronominal -ⲙⲏⲧⲛⲉ. Equivalent to Sah. ⲛⲙ̄ⲙⲏⲧⲛ̄.
Lyc. reflex of ϩⲓⲧⲉϩⲏ 'before, in front of.' Spatial/temporal preposition used here adverbially.
Greek loanword παρεμβολή 'military encampment, array.' Singular form here (cf. plural ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲟⲗⲁⲩⲉ already in vocabulary). Standard Manichaean martial-cosmological term.
Greek loanword σπουδαῖος 'diligent, earnest, zealous.' Paired here with τέλειος 'perfect.' Standard Christian-Manichaean ascetic ideal.
